items.name: Organic Egyptian Black Seed Oil
items.note: Vitamin A (Retinoids): Accelerates cellular turnover. This process sheds dead skin cells faster, preventing them from mixing with sebum and clogging pores. It actively fades post-acne dark spots and smooths rough skin texture. Vitamin B Complex (principally Niacinamide equivalents): Synthesizes ceramides and fatty acids within the lipid barrier. This fortification prevents transepidermal water loss (TEWL), keeping dry or sensitive skin deeply hydrated and shielded from environmental irritants. Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid): Acts as a vital cofactor for collagen synthesis. It neutralizes free radicals from UV exposure and pollution, while inhibiting the tyrosinase enzyme to reduce hyperpigmentation and brighten skin tone. Vitamin E (Tocopherols): Works alongside Vitamin C to provide lipophilic (fat-soluble) antioxidant defense. It stabilizes cell membranes, prevents lipid peroxidation (which hardens sebum into blackheads), and deeply soothes irritation. Zinc: Functions as a potent anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent. It suppresses Cutibacterium acnes (the bacteria responsible for breakouts) and regulates the 5-alpha reductase enzyme to curb excessive oil production. Calcium: Resides primarily in the outermost layer of the skin (the epidermis), where it regulates the rapid differentiation of skin cells. A healthy calcium gradient ensures efficient barrier repair and maintains optimal sebum balance. Magnesium and Potassium: These minerals maintain osmotic pressure within skin tissues. They reduce swelling, calm stress-induced skin flare-ups, and improve overall cell hydration and metabolism. The vitamins and minerals in black seed oil are heavily amplified by its unique phytochemical composition. Thymoquinone (TQ): The primary active compound, drastically reduces redness and swelling by inhibiting pro-inflammatory cytokines like interleukins (IL-1, IL-2, IL-6). It also triggers tissue growth and fibroblastic proliferation to accelerate wound and scar healing.Essential Fatty Acids (EFAs): Contains up to 60% Linoleic Acid (Omega-6) and 20% Oleic Acid (Omega-9). Oily and acne-prone skin is typically deficient in linoleic acid, making sebum thick and sticky. Supplying linoleic acid thins out the sebum, which decongests pores and reduces breakouts.

items.name: Shea Butter
items.role: Natural lasting moisture and skin rejuvenation.
items.note: Contains: Vitamin E: A powerful antioxidant to protect skin cells from free radicals & premature aging. Vitamin A: Promotes cell regeneration & helps soothe dry or irritated skin. Vitamin F: A rich blend of essential fatty acids that help maintain the skin's barrier & elasticity. Vitamin D: Helps rejuvenate skin. Essential Fatty Acids: Dense in oleic acid, stearic acid, linoleic acid, & palmitic acid (highly effective emollients that soften & deeply moisturize). Minerals & Other Bioactive Compounds: Allantoin: Known for its healing, anti-inflammatory properties, which help soothe eczema or minor abrasions. Triterpenes: These natural compounds help boost collagen production & minimize the destruction of collagen fibers. Phenolic Compounds: Contains antioxidants similar to those found in green tea, which further help fight off oxidative stress.

items.name: Organic Apricot Seed Oil
items.note: Contains: Vitamin E: A powerful antioxidant that protects skin cells from environmental stressors, such as UV rays and pollution, which helps combat premature aging. Vitamin A: Promotes skin cell turnover and rejuvenation, which helps reduce the appearance of fine lines and maintains skin elasticity. Vitamin C: Acts as a brightening agent and antioxidant that supports collagen production and guards against free radicals. Essential Fatty Acids: Oleic Acid (Omega-9): A rich, moisturizing fatty acid that softens the skin and acts as an emollient to seal in moisture. Linoleic Acid (Omega-6): Helps strengthen the skin’s natural lipid barrier and regulate moisture loss. Gamma-Linolenic Acid (GLA): Helps reduce skin inflammation and aids in soothing sensitive or irritated skin. Minerals: Contains trace amounts of essential minerals like potassium, magnesium, and calcium that support overall skin health and cellular function. Phytosterols: Plant compounds that help protect the collagen in your skin, promote hydration, and relieve itchy or dry skin.

items.name: Aloe Vera
items.role: Boosts collagen production and brightens skin.
items.note: Contains: Vitamin A (Beta-Carotene): Supports skin cell turnover, helps repair damaged tissue, and keeps the complexion clear by addressing breakouts. Vitamin C: A potent antioxidant that protects against environmental damage, brightens dull skin, and boosts collagen production for improved elasticity. Vitamin E: Combats free radicals to prevent premature aging and deeply nourishes dry skin by maintaining its natural barrier. Vitamin B12 & Folic Acid: Assists in the production of new skin cells, aiding the body's natural healing and cell regeneration processes. Zinc: Acts as a natural astringent and anti-inflammatory agent, making it highly effective at fighting acne and calming irritated skin. Magnesium: Known as the "anti-stress" mineral, it helps calm sensitivity, reduces inflammation, and protects the skin barrier from sun damage. Potassium: Plays a crucial role in maintaining skin hydration levels and ensuring the barrier functions properly. Copper & Selenium: Provide antioxidant properties and support structural proteins to keep the skin firm and resilient.

items.name: Siberian Sea Buckthorn Oil
items.note: Contains: Extraordinary levels of Vitamin C, alongside Vitamin E, Vitamin K, and B-complex vitamins. Essential Fatty Acids: It is one of the few plant sources that contains the entire spectrum of Omegas: Omega-3, -6, -9, and the rare Omega-7, which is highly valued for cell regeneration. Antioxidants: Packed with flavonoids, quercetin, and carotenoids (such as beta-carotene). Amino Acids: Contains 18 amino acids, including essential ones the human body cannot produce itself.

items.name: Organic Carrot Seed Oil
items.note: Contains: Beta-Carotene (Provitamin A): that acts as a natural retinol, boosting cell regeneration, evening out skin tone, and minimizing the appearance of fine lines without irritation. Vitamin E: A heavy-duty antioxidant that neutralizes free radicals, protects the skin barrier, and deeply moisturizes. Vitamin C: Aids in collagen formation, which brightens the complexion and helps heal sun-damaged or scarred skin. Essential Fatty Acids (Omega-6 and Omega-9): These support the skin's natural lipid barrier, ensuring moisture retention and keeping skin both young and supple.

items.name: Pectin
items.role: Helps skin retain moisture and prevent aging.
items.note: A Natural Humectant: Pectin naturally binds water, making it an excellent plant-based moisturizer that helps the skin retain hydration and prevents transepidermal water loss. Barrier Support: It forms a lightweight, protective film on the skin's surface, keeping it smooth and shielding it from environmental stressors. Antioxidant Delivery: Pectin is typically rich in fruit polyphenols and galacturonic acid.

items.name: Organic Castor Oil
items.note: Contains: Ricinoleic Acid: This unique fatty acid is responsible for the vast majority of castor oil's anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and deep-moisturizing properties. Vitamin E: It is rich in tocopherols (part of the Vitamin E family), which act as natural antioxidants. This helps protect your skin and hair from oxidative stress and free radical damage. Omega Fatty Acids: Contains beneficial amounts of Omega-6 and Omega-9 fatty acids, which help nourish and support the skin barrier. Minerals: Contains trace amounts of foundational minerals including magnesium, zinc, and iron. Proteins: Contains proteins and amino acids that help nourish hair roots and strengthen the skin barrier.

items.name: Kokum Butter
items.role: Uniquely dense in vitamin E and doesn't clog pores.
items.note: Contains : Vitamin E (Tocopherol): Kokum butter contains a high concentration of natural Vitamin E. This fat-soluble antioxidant shields the skin from environmental stressors while actively repairing a physically cracked or peeling moisture barrier. Stearic Acid: This is the dominant nutrient in kokum butter. On the skin, it acts as a premier emollient, locking in hydration and forming a protective seal without a heavy or suffocating residue. Oleic Acid: A monounsaturated Omega-9 fatty acid that penetrates into the surface layers of the skin. It deeply moisturizes dry tissue, softens skin texture, and enhances overall firmness. Garcinol: A highly studied, powerful polyisoprenylated benzophenone compound unique to the Garcinia genus. Garcinol provides potent anti-inflammatory and antibacterial defense, helping to calm irritated skin and curb acne breakouts.

items.name: Cacay Oil
items.role: Vitamin A (retinol) and vitamin E powerhouse.
items.note: Contains: Natural Vitamin A (Retinol): Cacay oil contains three times more natural Vitamin A than rosehip oil. It delivers natural retinoid precursors that your skin enzymes seamlessly convert into retinoic acid. This accelerates cellular turnover, reduces hyperpigmentation, and boosts collagen synthesis without causing the flaking, redness, or sun-sensitivity associated with synthetic prescription retinoids. Vitamin E : It boasts 50% more Vitamin E than argan oil. This fat-soluble antioxidant neutralizes free radicals, stabilizes the skin's lipid barrier, protects against UV oxidative damage, and increases overall skin elasticity. Vitamin F (Essential Fatty Acids): Over 70% of cacay oil consists of pure Omega-6. This is twice the amount found in argan oil. Linoleic acid is an essential nutrient that acne-prone and dry skin types are severely deficient in. It thins out sticky sebum to prevent clogged pores while deeply reinforcing a compromised skin barrier. Squalene: Cacay oil is a rich, natural plant source of squalene. This nutrient mimics a core component of human sebum, allowing the oil to sink deeply and rapidly into the skin without leaving a heavy, sticky, or occlusive residue. Omega-9: It contains a controlled, low fraction (roughly 10%–14%) of oleic acid. This provides just enough emollient softening for dry areas without disrupting the skin barrier or triggering irritation in reactive skin types.

items.name: Tamanu Oil
items.role: Rare plant compounds that heal and restore.
items.note: Contains: Vitamin E (Delta-Tocotrienol): Tamanu oil is rich in vitamin E, which acts as a potent antioxidant to defend your skin against free radical damage and premature aging. Vitamin B Complex: Contains various B vitamins that support healthy skin regeneration, helping to even out skin tone and improve overall texture. Omega Fatty Acids: It delivers a deep dose of essential lipids, including linoleic acid (Omega-6) to balance oil production, oleic acid (Omega-9) for intense moisture, and palmitic and stearic acids to reinforce the skin's protective barrier. Calophyllolide: This is a rare, unique compound found almost exclusively in tamanu oil. It boasts impressive anti-inflammatory properties making it highly effective at calming irritated or sensitive skin. Xanthones & Coumarins: These are powerful plant antioxidants that provide the oil with strong antibacterial and antifungal capabilities, helping to soothe acne and minor skin infections.

items.name: Organic Greek Olive oil
items.role: Richest botanical source of squalene in the world.
items.note: Contains: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol): Olive oil is heavily packed with natural alpha-tocopherol. This is the most biologically active form of Vitamin E for human tissue. It functions as a defense shield, neutralizing free radicals caused by pollution and UV light, which prevents premature structural skin aging. Squalene: Olive oil is the richest botanical source of squalene in the world. Squalene naturally makes up about 10%–14% of human skin sebum, meaning your skin recognizes it immediately. It sinks deeply into the epidermis to prevent moisture evaporation without leaving a suffocating film. Oleic Acid (Omega-9): Composing roughly 73% of the oil, oleic acid is the dominant fatty acid. It softens rough textures and acts as a powerful penetration enhancer, helping other skincare actives applied underneath absorb more effectively into deeper tissue. Polyphenols (Oleocanthal & Oleuropein):  On the skin, they act as localized anti-inflammatory agents that calm redness, soothe irritation from conditions like eczema, and aid in cellular wound recovery.

items.name: Amla Oil
items.role: Exceptionally high levels of vitamin c for skin brightening and anti-aging.
items.note: Contains: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid): Amla fruit features an exceptionally high concentration of natural Vitamin C—roughly 10 times more than oranges by weight. In amla oil, this Vitamin C acts as a premier brightening agent, helping to suppress dark spots, even out skin tone, and directly fuel collagen synthesis to keep skin firm. Tannin-Bound Polyphenols: Amla oil is densely packed with specialized antioxidants like gallic acid, ellagic acid, and corilagin. Crucially, the Vitamin C in amla is naturally bound to these tannins, making it highly stable against heat and light degradation, allowing it to penetrate the skin more effectively than unstable synthetic ascorbic acid. Essential Fatty Acids: Inherited from its lipid extraction base and the amla seeds, the oil provides a massive dose of Linoleic Acid (Omega-6) and Oleic Acid (Omega-9). These essential lipids coat the skin to prevent transepidermal water loss and repair a cracked or dry skin barrier. Flavonoids & Bioactive Alkaloids: These plant compounds possess strong anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. They work on a cellular level to inhibit elastase (the enzyme that breaks down skin elasticity) while calming inflammatory redness and acne irritation.

items.name: Mango Butter
items.role: Heavily packed with Vitamin E and Vitamin A, balanced by a dense profile of skin-softening fatty acids.
items.note: Contains: Vitamin E (Tocopherol): Mango butter is rich in natural Vitamin E, a powerful fat-soluble antioxidant. It works to neutralize environmental free radicals, prevent oxidative stress, and actively calm inflammation in dry, irritated skin. Vitamin A (Retinol): It contains notable amounts of natural Vitamin A. This nutrient stimulates surface cellular turnover, helps to even out skin tone, and encourages collagen production to maintain elasticity and plumpness. Oleic Acid (Omega-9): Composing roughly 40%–50% of the butter, this monounsaturated fatty acid delivers deep, long-lasting moisture. It absorbs smoothly into the skin to soften rough patches and repair a compromised skin barrier. Stearic Acid: Making up about 40%–45% of its structure, this saturated fatty acid gives mango butter its solid form. On the skin, it acts as a superior emollient, forming a protective, velvety shield that seals in moisture without leaving a greasy residue. Linoleic Acid (Omega-6): Present in smaller, controlled amounts, this essential fatty acid assists in maintaining cell membrane integrity and preventing transepidermal water loss. Plant Phytosterols: These natural compounds mimic the cholesterol found in the human skin barrier. They help soothe redness, relieve itching from dry conditions, and support overall skin structural integrity.
